messages:
ashley: Heads-up — upstream pushed an OpenSSL patch (OpenSSL 3.1.2, CVE-2026-21458). It fixes a TLS renegotiation edge-case that can cause session confusion when using resumed sessions. Our ubuntu:20.04-minimal base (used in private deployment images + a few dedicated stacks) pulls libssl from distro packages, so I think we need a coordinated rebuild + re-sign of affected images. Proposing: rebuild minimal base, run compatibility suite, cosign attestation with KMS-backed key, promote via canary. Thoughts on RBAC for the signer and audit log retention?

jordan: How widespread is this in our fleet? Which images exactly use ubuntu:20.04-minimal? Any on-prem customers pinned to that base?

ashley: Quick list: private-deploy-runtime:ubuntu20.04-minimal (on-prem installer), redwood-runtime/dedicated-worker:20.04-minimal (dedicated pools), a couple of CI test images. A handful of enterprise customers pinned older manifests — we need to notify them. No immediate evidence of exploitation but severity is ~High/CRITICAL depending on deployment.

kevin: Triage notes: CVE looks exploitable in certain TLS renegotiation flows; severity depends on whether servers enable renegotiation and session-resumption behavior. For our stacks it's risky enough to prioritize. Proposed rollout: 1) build patch images with distro backport (apt pin + rebuild), 2) run binary-compat + integration tests, 3) push to staging registries, 4) canary to non-prod and 15% of dedicated traffic, 5) full promotion. Need rollback plan if latency/regressions appear.

wang: On signer RBAC: current key in KMS is accessible to broad CI principal. We should create a scoped principal/service-account `image-signer@redwood` with only the following permissions: kms.cryptoSign on the signing key, storage.objects.create for signed artifacts, and iam.serviceAccounts.get for attestor verification. Rotate the signing key after this incident and add a short TTL for ephemeral signer tokens. Also enable object-level audit logs for the GCR/GCS bucket (retain 90 days minimum, 1 year for enterprise customers who requested longer retention). cc @sec-bot for /audit hooks.

sec-bot: Automations: detected PR to container-ci (branch: osh/openssl-221900) — triggered build pipeline `container-ci/rebuild-minimal:openssh-221900`. Artifact will land in `gcr.redwood-inference/staging/ubuntu20.04-minimal/2219001111`. Attestation step queued (cosign + KMS).

sarah: CI checklist to add (short):
- build: `./ci/build-rootfs --distro focal --minimal --with-backports`
- tests: `smoke`, `tls-integration`, `compat-binaries`
- sbom: generate SPDX + json-sbom, upload to artifacts
- sign: `cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/signing/cryptoKeys/img-sign`
- attestation: include SBOM hash and CI run id
Example cosign command we plan to standardize:
```
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/signer --output-signature sig.asc gcr.redwood-inference/staging/ubuntu20.04-minimal:2219001111
```
Add PR template checkboxes for RBAC review and KMS key usage approval.

ashley: Schedule and comms: I'll kick off the rebuild tonight (start: 03:00 UTC). Target timeline: canary -> 06:00 UTC, monitor for 4 hours, then promote if green. Notify customers pinned to manifests and open a support banner for enterprise customers. Action items: (1) @wang create `image-signer` SA + IAM policy and set KMS policy; (2) @sarah add CI jobs and SBOM; (3) @kevin run compatibility matrix and smoke; (4) @jordan coordinate customer comms. I'll post a short runbook in #incidents once we have canary IDs.

jordan: :thumbsup: Please add a short rollback trigger (e.g., promote previous image tag and revoke attestation) and confirm we can revoke a signed tag quickly. Also update the private deploy docs to call out pinned manifests and how to opt into auto-updates.

ashley: Agreed — rollback will be: promote `:previous-stable` tag and blacklist offending digest at the router level, then notify. I'll include revocation steps in the runbook. Will follow up with a brief postmortem template even if this is a proactive rebuild.

sec-bot: Canary build completed: artifact `gcr.redwood-inference/staging/ubuntu20.04-minimal:2219001111` signed. Attestation ID `attest-221900-01`. Running smoke tests now (tls-integration queued).
